title: EOSC Finnish Forum webinar: RDA Plenary 27 and EOSC Symposium 2026 highlights
content:
October is a busy month! The 27th RDA Plenary takes place in London 6th-8th October, and the annual EOSC Symposium meets in Florence, 14th-16th October. At this EOSC Finnish Forum webinar, we will hear from CSC's RDA organisational assembly representative Anu Märkälä (CSC) on this year's highlights, and from EOSC Finland representative Ulriika Vihervalli (CSC) on what to expect from the EOSC Symposium. Come along to learn the latest on RDA and EOSC developments – the webinar will help you assess if participating in London and/or Florence is worth your and your organisation's while.

The webinar will be held in English. The agenda is subject to change.

Register here!

Agenda

  • 5' Introduction
  • 15' RDA Plenary 27 highlights (Anu Märkälä, CSC)
  • 15' EOSC Symposium 2026: highlights and key developments (Ulriika Vihervalli, CSC)
  • 10' Q&A-osio
